prompt: Original instrumental for a futuristic anti-gravity racing game: high-octane hard rock and speed metal at 165 BPM. A screaming, catchy, heroic lead guitar melody, fast palm-muted riffs, double-kick drums, a pumping bass, a crazy guitar solo with whammy dives in the middle, then a key change into a huge final chorus. Pure adrenaline, the energy of late-1990s console racing music with modern production. No vocals, no spoken words.
